connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.source:
Establishes a connection to an AMQP 1.0 message broker for sending and receiving messages.

Supports plaintext (`amqp://`) and TLS-encrypted (`amqps://`) connections with SASL authentication (credentials in the URL or configured separately).
connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.message:
Nastaví spojenie s brokerom správ AMQP 1.0 na odosielanie a prijímanie správ.

Podporuje nešifrované (`amqp://`) a šifrované TLS (`amqps://`) spojenia so SASL overením (poverenia v URL alebo nakonfigurované samostatne).

connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.source:
Comma-separated list of AMQP addresses (queues or topics) to expose as child data providers.

Each address supports sending messages and receiving events.
connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.message:
Zoznam AMQP adries oddelený čiarkami (fronty alebo témy), ktoré sa majú vystaviť ako poddodávateľské zdroje.

Každá adresa podporuje odosielanie správ a prijímanie udalostí.

connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.source: AMQP addresses to expose as providers
connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.message: AMQP adresy na vystavenie ako dodávateľov

connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.source:
Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for AMQP operations.

Increase for high-latency networks or heavily loaded brokers.
connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.message:
Maximálny čas v milisekundách, počas ktorého sa čaká na AMQP operácie.

Zvýšiť pre siete s vysokou latenciou alebo pre preťažené brokery.

connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.source: Timeout for AMQP operations in milliseconds
connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.message: Časový limit AMQP operácií v milisekundách

connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.source:
When enabled, queries the broker via the AMQP Management Protocol to automatically discover available addresses.

**Note:** not all brokers support this protocol.
connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.message:
Keď je povolené, dotazuje broker cez AMQP Management Protocol na automatické zistenie dostupných adries.

**Poznámka:** nie všetky brokery tento protokol podporujú.

connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.source: Query the broker for available addresses
connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.message: Dotaz na broker pre dostupné adresy

connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.source: Connect to an AMQP 1.0 message broker
connection.QW1xcERhdGFQcm92aWRlcg.scheme.message: Pripojiť sa k brokerovi správ AMQP 1.0
